name: SynFlowNet/gflownet
research_q: 如何设计一种生成模型，在分子生成过程中显式整合化学合成约束，以解决现有模型生成分子合成不可达的问题，并提升样本多样性？
limits: leaving no guarantee that the sampled molecules can be synthesized
these heuristics and learned metrics are often oversimplified
it can take seconds to minutes to propose pathways, which hampers its integration as a reward function
old_forms: assemble molecules by composing atoms or molecular fragments into a graph
computer-aided synthesis planning can be performed as a subsequent step to molecule generation

arch_modules.name: Graph Transformer
arch_modules.role: 处理分子状态并生成共享嵌入

arch_modules.name: MLP Heads
arch_modules.role: 预测不同动作类型（前向5种，反向3种）的logits

arch_modules.name: Reward Function
arch_modules.role: 评估最终分子的奖励（如结合亲和力）

key_challenge: 反应基于MDP中反向构建轨迹缺乏返回初始状态s0的保证，导致反向策略训练困难。
why_not_other: 传统基于原子或片段的生成模型无法保证合成可行性；合成规划作为后处理步骤耗时过长，难以集成到生成奖励中。
